description: Curated issuer groups (TDM brief R9 HS4). No free machine-readable source exists (SPARK/Cbonds are paid; EGRUL does not disclose PAO shareholders), so groups are curated here, keyed by the INN MOEX publishes for the issuer (emitter_id cross-checks the match). Every row carries evidence: the MOEX emitter card that identifies the issuer and the document that states the relation. group_relation: parent | subsidiary | spv | securitization_spv | affiliate. is_state_owned is set only where an evidence document states it (null = not established). sector = sector of the group (mdhub/data/sector_map.json taxonomy): SPVs take it, securitization SPVs are securitization_spv. Job issuers_static writes the groups to ref.issuer (history in ops.row_history). Review: owner/desk; extend with evidence per row.
